blind.description: A classical garden statue of a draped woman (reminiscent of Ceres/Demeter) holding a sheaf of wheat under her right arm, mounted on a square molded stone pedestal. The surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with well-defined sculpted folds and features. The material resembles weathered beige limestone or marble with subtle ambient dirt shading in recesses.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as the top of a stone head with hair tied back, draped shoulders, and a bundle of wheat heads protruding to one side, all resting on the flat top of a square stone plinth.
blind.height_vs_figure: Total height including plinth is roughly equal to the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 5 ft 8 in to 6 ft tall), with a plinth footprint around 1.5 to 2 ft wide.
